quote: The amendments made by subsections (b) through (f) take effect on the first day of the first fiscal year quarter that begins after the date of enactment of this Act.
why: Sec. 2402(g) delays the sec. 2402 amendments to 1915(i) to the first fiscal quarter after enactment (sec. 2401 adds 1915(k) operative October 1, 2010; sec. 2601 has no timing provision); nothing reaches back.
Title V amendments to RFPA section 1114 (secs. 501-503) carry no effective-date provision (the 180-day delay covers only secs. 101-103), so they take effect on approval.
Sec. 4(a)(2) adds the chapter 47A exclusion to article 21 with no effective-date or applicability provision, so it takes effect on approval.
Division K sec. 421 adds paragraph (12) to section 33(b) with no timing provision, so it takes effect on approval.

quote: Except as otherwise provided in this title, the amendments made by this title shall take effect as if included in the provisions of the Taxpayer Relief Act of 1997 to which they relate.
why: Sec. 6005(f) technical amendments to section 1045 (related to sec. 313 of the 1997 Act) take effect under sec. 6024 as if included in the Taxpayer Relief Act of 1997.
Sec. 514(a) substitutes Papa Ola Lokahi in section 10 of the Native Hawaiian Health Care Improvement Act with no timing provision, so it takes effect on approval.
Division H sec. 150 (Fern Lake Conservation and Recreation Act) contains no effective-date provision, so it takes effect on approval.
Sec. 701(b)(1) redefines pay-per-call services in 15 U.S.C. 5714(1); the only nearby effective-date clause covers subsection (a)(1), so the amendment takes effect on approval.

quote: The amendments made by this section shall apply to fuels or liquids removed, entered, or sold after September 30, 2005.
why: The main sec. 11161 kerosene amendments to section 4081 apply only to fuel removed, entered or sold after September 30, 2005 (other amendments: sec. 11101 and 11166 on enactment, sec. 11151(b) as if included in the 2004 Act).

quote: Except as otherwise provided in this title, this title and the amendments made by this title shall take effect on the date of the enactment of this Act.
why: Sec. 105(a) makes the sec. 102(d) amendment to section 411(a) effective on enactment without limiting or extending its reach.
